# Marks Where the Boats Cannot Go

*Eilidh's slate, Agna's notch and the dead pines agree with Ailsa's pages. She wants tide marks driven where the wardens' boats cannot go.*

## Objectives

1. Deliver 1 [Eilidh's Tide Slate](../items/eilidhs_slate.md)
2. Look at the Jaw's waterline in [The Forest Jaw](../maps/forest_jaw.md)
3. Look at the west skerry in [The Skerries](../maps/skerries.md)
4. Look at the east skerry in [The Skerries](../maps/skerries.md)
5. Look at the middle skerry in [The Skerries](../maps/skerries.md)
6. Defeat 50 [Wrackgolem](../monsters/wrackgolem.md) in [The Skerries](../maps/skerries.md)
7. Defeat 50 [Grey Bull](../monsters/grey_bull.md) in [The Skerries](../maps/skerries.md)

## Rewards

- 48,500 EXP
- 2,300 mesos
- +40 standing with Goa Harbour
- +200 standing with [Ailsa](../npcs/ailsa_tidebook.md)
